title: release-day-quick-logbook
content:
Personal quick log for release day - keep this lightweight.

Context:
- Release: v3.8.0 -> rolling deploy to hosted + dedicated (EU, us-west-2).
- Owner (on-call cutover): Ava M. (this doc). Backup: Daniel C.
- Windows: short maintenance window starting 09:30 UTC; main traffic shift 10:00-10:30 UTC.

Pre-cutover (T-60 to T-10)
- [ ] Confirm infra autoscaler health in console (route: /infra/autoscaler) - look for steady instance spinups/downs in last 24h.
- [ ] Verify quota tokens for dedicated pools: dedicated-eu-queue showing reserved=320, available>=64.
- [ ] Ensure canary config uploaded: canary-config/v3.8.0.json on S3 (s3://redwood-configs/canary).
- [ ] Run dry-run of rollout script: ./scripts/rollout.sh --dry-run --env hosted --model gptq-4b --seq 1024 (watch for config merge errors).
- [ ] Post a short note to #releases: "Cutover on track 09:30 UTC, will update at go/no-go at 09:10" (use this template).

Quick notes to self:
- If S3 credentials error: check vault path secret/infra/s3-cutover and rotate if needed.
- Keep an eye on token costs in console; mid-cutover spiky sampling can inflate cost.

Canary window (T+0 to T+20)
- At 09:30 UTC: flip canary route to 5% traffic. Command: curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/routes/canary -d '{"percent":5,"config":"v3.8.0"}' (use curl from bastion with ADMIN_TOKEN).
- [ ] Monitor latency p50/p95 for canary (dashboard: /dashboards/canary-latency).
- [ ] Watch error budget in SLOs: if error_rate > 0.8% for 5m -> pause rollout.
- [ ] Check model outputs for prompt-set sample (evals: evals/cutover-2026-03) - compare BLEU-like metrics, qualitative sniff.
- Quick rollback: POST /admin/rollbacks -d '{"target":"previous","reason":"canary fail"}' (handy when threshold crossed).

Full rollout (T+20 to T+60)
- [ ] Increase to 25% at T+20 if canary stable. Note: warmup for kv-cache should reduce latency within 2 windows.
- [ ] At 25% watch throughput and GPU saturated metrics; if avg GPU util > 92% for 3 samples, throttle to 15% and alert infra.
- [ ] 50% at T+35 if stable. 100% at T+55 if all green.

Post-cutover smoke tests
- [ ] Run smoke script: ./tests/smoke_cutover.sh --routes hosted,dedicated --seq 512.
- [ ] Verify tracing spans appear in console (trace id sampler 1% should show new model label v3.8.0).
- [ ] Confirm logs archived: indexer shows all NEW logs tagged v3.8.0-uploaded.

Backports / cherry-picks (local reminders)
- core/inference: backport PR #821 -> branch rel/v3.8 (done by hand, watch change in kv cache handling).
- infra/launcher: backport #788 (ensure systemd unit reload included).
- console: small CSS fix not required for rollout, mark for post-release patch.
- [ ] Add to release notes: backport list + known incompatibility with old batcher config.

Comms checklist
- [ ] Slack: post cutover start (channel #releases), update at each major step (canary, 25%, 100%).
- [ ] PagerDuty: if any latency SLO breach -> trigger on-call rotation and page SRE lead (Daniel).
- [ ] Customer email: only if any region degraded >30m. Draft saved in drafts/release-emails/v3.8.0.md.

Emergency rollback plan (fast)
- If critical errors: run emergency script from bastion: ./emergency/rollback-to-prev.sh --force --note "auto-rollback by Ava"
- Post-rollback checklist: revert canary config if not automatically undone, escalate with release lead.
- Preserve logs: tag all logs for period 09:00-11:00 with label "rollback-investigation".

Open questions / TODOs to handle during cutover
- Can we safely increase batch size for dedicated pools without changing latency SLO? (ping Priya)
- Confirm that's okay to enable experimental quantization profile q3 on dedicated if cost spikes. (defer if in doubt)
- Verify if downstream partner (search team) expects model id change event; if yes, send webhook.

Quick command cheatsheet (stash here)
- Check rollout status: curl -s $ADMIN_API/rollout/status | jq .
- Pause rollout: curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/rollout/pause -d '{"reason":"manual-pause"}'
- Re-deploy dedicated pool: ./ops/deploy_pool.sh --pool dedicated-eu --version v3.8.0

Notes after 10:15 UTC (live log)
- 09:30 canary -> latency +7ms p95, no errors, sample outputs look identical.
- 09:52 bumped to 25% -> slight GPU bump on dedicated-eu but stable.
- 10:05 50% -> 1 minor tracer error (ID T-8893) traced to a logging flub; low severity.
- Next: decide 100% at 10:25 if no further anomalies.

End-of-day wrap (reminders)
- [ ] Write post-mortem notes even if everything OK: quick 1-paragraph summary + links.
- [ ] Merge any hotfix backports into main and rel branches.
- [ ] Update canary-config docs with lessons (short bullets).

Random personal reminders (because this is my scratchpad):
- Bring charger to on-call room.
- Check flight info for Wed.

-- Ava
